FISHING LICENCE · MOZAMBIQUE

Mozambique fishing licence

Each recreational angler needs a personal licence, including foreign visitors. The licence covers its issuing province; annual licences are limited to nationals and foreign residents.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Recreational anglers in marine and inland waters, with or without a boat.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Daily recreational licenceany1 daySee official site
Weekly recreational licenceany1 weekSee official site
Monthly recreational licenceany1 monthSee official site

Extra stamps and permits

  • Conservation-area access fee
    When fishing within a conservation area under its management plan.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Licensing is individual; arrange each client's licence as well as any boat and area permissions.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry identification that matches your personal licence.
  • Follow the province and dates on the licence.
  • An angler under 16 must have a parent, guardian or legal representative present.

How to buy

Apply to the provincial fisheries authority or its authorised issuing office with identification.

Do I need a fishing licence in Mozambique?

Each recreational angler needs a personal licence, including foreign visitors. The licence covers its issuing province; annual licences are limited to nationals and foreign residents.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Mozambique?
